## What it is

The tower at 0°, the right side, +X. One notch. Three clips on a 1 m strip. Not the start of the coil.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side. The clip C is the layer plane, which is the orientation that held together. Upright clips broke across the layers.
- The foot socket is a diamond with the point toward the top of this pose, so the roof is 45°.
- The lug is 6 mm inboard of the pin. Only the 0° pocket takes it.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print this standing up. That puts the layer lines along the tube.
- Don't put it on another pad. The lug will not enter.
